Duniyadari | Ep. 1758 | 11th November, 2026
In today's episode, Nikita Agarwal talks about Alice Huang, who has gained notoriety for being the woman in the cheating scandal involving Nvidia’s Jensen Huang. Believed to be a spy, she is reported to have moved back to China at the end of 2025. However, she has not been seen since then, with even her social media accounts deleted. Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese asset, emerged from the high-flying world of Shanghai finance to work with tech titans and obtain essential A.I. Chips.
